objective: Author and freeze a fresh composite all_of challenge that discriminates child coverage, claim-native subject binding, scope binding, and expected evidence form without exposing development outcomes or post-reveal selection rules.
prereveal_allowed_knowledge: Each fresh parent has exactly two declared child propositions under all_of.
Evidence-obligation descriptors may copy exact subject/scope terms from the parent or child and may include a separately frozen experimental expected-evidence-form label.
The cohort must contain same-topic wrong-entity, wrong-scope, and wrong-form hard negatives.
Gold usefulness must not be defined by descriptor match.
Post-reveal selection budget is bounded and identical across arms.
prereveal_denylist: PR #109 and PR #110 bodies, diffs, comments, artifacts, checks, result branches, or source files
all Gate-specialty development/result PRs #95 through #108 and their answer-bearing artifacts
normal conversation or saved summaries describing which descriptor fields helped or failed
post-reveal selector implementation, cap choice, arm bindings, or expected winner
required_freeze_order: author and freeze exactly two meaning-preserving child propositions per parent with explicit all_of lineage
derive and freeze claim-native obligation descriptors before corpus authoring
author fresh corpora and intended-form metadata
run frozen retrieval and freeze candidate pools/scores
adjudicate candidate-level gold independently of descriptor match
contamination_rule: Any denylisted development result or post-reveal selector information opened before the prereveal freeze terminates the run as CONTAMINATED_PRE_FREEZE.
nonclaims: This bootstrap does not establish that subject, scope, form, or child coverage helps.
Claim-native identifiers are scope bindings, not answer labels.
Expected evidence form remains an experimental research field unless separately qualified.
